name: GLM 5.2 Coding
short: Z.ai's coding-positioned GLM-5.2 entry (MIT, 1M) - no separate 'GLM-5.2-Coding' SKU is published on Z.ai, Zen, OpenRouter or models.dev; SWE-bench 82.8% (Vals), tau2-bench 99.1% (AA), TB 2.1 81.0% (vendor) / 67.8% (Vals).
standout: Near-perfect tool orchestration (tau2-bench 99.1%) on MIT-licensed MoE weights you can self-host.
tradeoff: The coding focus narrows general breadth — and the coding SKU itself is unverified: the published 'SWE-bench 78.7%' claim could not be found in any source.
